identity.question: Pedro Sánchez out as PM of Spain by December 31, 2026?

facts.source: BOE Real Decreto 806/2026 (BOE-A-2026-20742), same previously captured HTML body
facts.finding: Article 5 says the chambers resulting from the Nov 29 election convene in constituent sessions on Dec 23, 2026 at 10:00. This corrects work/0386_facts_1935.json wording that the decree sets no new Congress session date. It does not set the successor’s investiture or the date Sánchez ceases to hold the personal office.

facts.publisher: EL PAÍS / Cadena SER; commissioned survey conducted by 40dB.
facts.retrieval_note: EL PAÍS page linked the report (“Presentación del informe del Barómetro mensual”). Direct HTTP page request returned 403; browser-rendered public page and linked 28-page PDF were accessible. No byte-level raw capture/receipt was available in this bounded pass; do not imply a raw hash.
facts.population: Spain resident population, age 18+, voting right, excluding Ceuta and Melilla
facts.interpretation_limit: The survey reports stated party vote intention and a question on preferred President. Neither is a measurement of resignation/removal, PM tenure, investiture outcome, or legal effective departure. Party vote shares are not seat estimates or government formation certainty.
